attributes.input.value: Article 71 of the AI Act proposal sets the highest tier of administrative fines (up to €30,000,000 or 6% of turnover) for violations of two specific articles. What does each of those two articles require?
attributes.output.value:
Article 71(4)(a) prohibits non-compliance with AI practices in Article 5 and imposes fines up to €30 million or 6% of the company's global annual turnover.

Article 71(4)(b) requires non-compliance with requirements laid down in Article 10, also imposing fines up to €30 million or 6% of the company's global annual turnover.
